info.cls_ename: Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程為航太工程科系學生在燃氣渦輪機與噴射推進方面之基礎導論課程。課程中將介紹各式飛行器噴射引擎之類別、操作原理、渦輪引擎組件與功能、火箭引擎與吸氣式引擎之差別、飛行器與噴射引擎之性能參數、一維氣體動力學、超音速與次音速噴嘴與擴散器、噴嘴流特性、超音速與次音速進氣道、渦輪引擎熱力循環─Brayton Cycle
description.describe_eh: This course provides an introduction to the fundamentals of gas turbine engines and jet propulsion for aerospace students. The course contains introduction of categories and operating principles of aircraft jet engines, components of jet engines, differences between rocket mortos and air-breathing engines; performance parameters of aircraft and jet engines, basic concepts of one-dimensional gas dynamics; supersonic and subsonic nozzles and diffusers, nozzle flow characteristics, supersonic and subsonic inlets, thermodynamics cycle of turbo-engines - Brayton cycle.

targets.describe_ch: 使學生瞭解噴射推進基本概念、渦輪引擎類別、組件與操作原理
targets.describe_en: To acquire an understanding of the basic concepts of jet propulsion, classification of turbo-engines, engine components, and working principles.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生瞭解飛行器與渦輪引擎性能定義與建立評估能力
targets.describe_en: To acquire an understanding of definitions of aircraft/engine performance parameters and build up the ability of evaluation.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生利用一維氣體動力學分析引擎推力與噴嘴流之能力
targets.describe_en: To develop the ability of 1-D gas dynamics analysis for engine thrust and nozzle flow.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生瞭解渦輪引擎熱力循環與效率分析
targets.describe_en: To acquire an understanding of  thermodynamics cycle of turbo-engines  ( Brayton cycle) and gain the ability of thermodynamics efficiency analysis
